name: SyMo Launcher
description:
Panel launcher for SyMo, a lightweight system monitor with tray metrics, graphs, power actions and Telegram/Discord notifications.

The button hides while SyMo's own tray icon is on the panel, so there is never a second icon. If the system cannot show tray icons, the button stays and offers to install tray icon support.

The SyMo application must be installed separately: https://github.com/OlegEgoism/SyMo
